# Cncf Aws Cloudformation Reviewer

Review AWS CloudFormation using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. AWS CloudFormation provides a common language for you to describe and provision all the infrastructure resources in your cloud environment.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
